SessionStart.bash: sh -c 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || root="$PWD"; if [ -x "$root/node_modules/.bin/agnostic-ai" ]; then exec "$root/node_modules/.bin/agnostic-ai" project -- hook memory --target copilot; fi; command -v agnostic-ai >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec agnostic-ai project -- hook memory --target copilot'
SessionStart.powershell: $root = (Get-Location).Path; if (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $top = git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null; if ($top) { $root = $top } }; $local = Join-Path $root 'node_modules/.bin/agnostic-ai.cmd'; if (Test-Path $local) { & $local project -- hook memory --target copilot } elseif (Get-Command agnostic-ai -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { agnostic-ai project -- hook memory --target copilot }
